snippet.title: My Rusty Submarine - New Waters [Trailer]
snippet.description:
Hello there divers! 
It's finally time. 
Over 100.000 divers have gone on an adventure with us, so we thought we give this submarine some more polish.

My Rusty Submarine - New Waters is here!

Play the demo or buy the full game here: 
https://soerbgames.itch.io/my-rusty-submarine
